data.description:
Update all comment-only references to legacy keys in executable scripts and all ~14 SKILL.md / prompt instruction files to use dso.workflow language.

## Testing Mode: GREEN (no behavioral change — instruction file and comment updates only)

## Scope: Comment-only references in executable files
Update comments (not functional code) in:
- plugins/dso/hooks/lib/enforcement-gate.sh (lines 6, 31, 54, 61, 68 — after Task c9d5 updates functional code, comments remain)
- plugins/dso/hooks/pre-commit-review-gate.sh (line 44)
- plugins/dso/hooks/pre-commit-test-gate.sh (line 66)
- plugins/dso/hooks/pre-commit-test-quality-gate.sh (line 49)
- plugins/dso/scripts/commit-emit-skip-markers.sh (line 4)
- plugins/dso/hooks/lib/review-gate-bypass-sentinel.sh (comment refs)
- .github/workflows/ci.yml (lines 42, 94 — comments only)
- plugins/dso/hooks/lib/enforcement-gate-contract.md (update contract doc)

## Scope: SKILL.md and prompt instruction files
Find all files with legacy key refs:
  grep -rl 'merge\.strategy\|enforcement\.strategy\|worktree\.isolation_enabled\|attribution\.enabled\|DSO_SPRINT_MODE\|MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE' plugins/dso/skills/

Update each to use dso.workflow language:
- "merge.strategy=pr" → "dso.workflow=ci-pr"
- "enforcement.strategy=ci" → "dso.workflow=ci-pr"
- "DSO_SPRINT_MODE" → ".sprint-active marker" (where applicable)
- "MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE" → removed or replaced with dso.workflow context

Target files include (at minimum):
- plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md
- plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md
- plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md
- plugins/dso/skills/onboarding/SKILL.md
- plugins/dso/skills/review/SKILL.md
- plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/prompts/*.md
- plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/ci-skeleton-templates.md
- plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/single-agent-integrate.md
- plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/worktree-dispatch.md
- plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/*.md

## Verification
After all updates: run the grep-verification from Task 16a9:
  bash tests/scripts/test-legacy-cleanup-grep.sh

## Story DD Coverage
This task satisfies:
- DD2: All ~14 plugins/dso/skills/**/*.md files updated to use dso.workflow language
- DD1 (final piece): zero grep matches for legacy keys in the comment/instruction scope

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] bash tests/scripts/test-legacy-cleanup-grep.sh passes (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-legacy-cleanup-grep.sh
- [ ] All SKILL.md files updated: no legacy key refs in instruction text
  Verify: grep -rl 'merge\.strategy\|enforcement\.strategy\|DSO_SPRINT_MODE\|MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE' plugins/dso/skills/ 2>/dev/null | grep -v 'allowlisted' | wc -l | grep -q '^0$'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
data.title: GREEN: comment + SKILL.md text updates — eliminate all remaining legacy key references
